input.description: Reply to the approving review's suggestions

input.command:
start=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
prev=""
while true; do
  s=$(gh pr view 541 --json state,reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup 2>/dev/null) || { sleep 60; continue; }
  state=$(jq -r .state <<<"$s")
  decision=$(jq -r .reviewDecision <<<"$s")
  fails=$(jq -r '[.statusCheckRollup[] | select(.status=="COMPLETED" and (.conclusion=="FAILURE" or .conclusion=="TIMED_OUT" or .conclusion=="ACTION_REQUIRED")) | .name] | join(",")' <<<"$s")
  pending=$(jq -r '[.statusCheckRollup[] | select(.status!="COMPLETED")] | length' <<<"$s")
  newrev=$(gh api repos/awinogradov/code-assistants/pulls/541/reviews --jq "[.[] | select(.submitted_at > \"$start\")] | map(.state) | join(\",\")" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  cur="state=$state decision=$decision fails=$fails pending=$pending newreviews=$newrev"
  if [ "$cur" != "$prev" ]; then echo "$cur"; prev="$cur"; fi
  case "$state" in MERGED|CLOSED) exit 0;; esac
  if [ "$decision" = "APPROVED" ] && [ -z "$fails" ] && [ "$pending" = "0" ] && [ -n "$newrev" ]; then exit 0; fi
  if [ -n "$fails" ]; then exit 0; fi
  case "$newrev" in *CHANGES_REQUESTED*|*COMMENTED*) exit 0;; esac
  sleep 60
done
